violations.reason: At step 14, the agent attempted to book the second reservation using certificate_8998287 as a payment method. Step 16 shows the booking failed because certificate_8998287 was not found, and step 19 confirms the user profile no longer contains that certificate. The agent therefore attempted to use a payment method that was not already in the user profile, violating the policy requirement.
